COD.rationale: Content (red set), its presentation as a coordinate pattern, and an explicit origin/status string are all present for the same referent/time.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies colored content sets (red, blue) with coordinate listings.

D.rationale: An explicit origin/status JSON is attached to the identified content, distinguishing content from its provenance/status.

O.rationale: The content is presented as explicit coordinate sets (spatial/constituent pattern) for the same referent/time.
